turns.question: Our books close on Amsterdam time. What was our revenue in September 2026, cancelled orders left out, counting each order on its calendar day in Amsterdam?
turns.answer: September 2026 revenue (1 to 30 September, UTC days, cancelled orders left out) was EUR 12,582.75; the semantic layer has no Amsterdam-day definition, so this is not the Amsterdam-calendar figure. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
